content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Springfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then document your hands-on project leadership experience. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify you meet the credential's prerequisites.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Springfield-area professionals attend interactive sessions covering the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam-aligned content. You'll earn all required contact hours and receive a Granite PM Academy certificate of completion.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you've finished the 35-hour course, apply directly to PMI and pay the examination fee. Include your Granite PM Academy course certificate and document your project experience hours. PMI will review and approve your application before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guidance to sharpen your readiness. You'll take the computer-based PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our instructors remain available to address final questions before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you'll enter a standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through project work, training, and community involvement to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to support your continuous learning.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
